investigations.summary: PMM-T156 failed again on the ps-replication-psmdb-sharded shard in all 9 e2e runs that ran tests (docker, docker arm64, ami, helm, ha, compat 3.7.1/3.8.0/3.8.1/3.9.0); same N/A-as-NaN cause, fix PR #1575 still open, not merged.

Second night in a row: GitHub runners' Ubuntu mirror azure.archive.ubuntu.com (40.119.46.219) gave 'Connection timed out' on apt installs inside DB containers ~00:57-02:20Z. That hung or failed pmm-framework setup: CLI jobs cancelled at the job timeout, PS 8.0 3.8.0 failed, both Docker-way upgrades failed, and the compat 3.9.1 e2e setup shard (haproxy, pdpgsql 17) failed so no tests ran. Mirror answers fine now (1 MB in 0.2 s). No VM run: a CHAOS VM cannot reproduce the runner-to-Azure path. Recurring, so a fallback mirror in pmm-framework is worth a human decision.

pmm3-ha-rosa #294 failed in Provision OpenShift Cluster: the new ROSA cluster's API host api.pmm-ha-rosa-294.izrd.p3.openshiftapps.com never resolved (6 min of 'no such host'), so no HA test ran. pmm3-ha-tests failed 4 nights running (#110-#113), after #106-#109 passed; #65's cause was a different ROSA step. Needs a human with ROSA access; no Jira found.
